title: Prospective study on predictors and course of psychological burden in patients with brain tumors and their next of kin
summary: Using questionnaires the psychological stress of patients with a new brain tumor diagnosis as well as their relatives will be examined.

interventions.name:
Patients with high grade glioma (HGG) WHO 4, low grade glioma (LGG) WHO 2 or 3 and Meningioma WHO 1
- Collection of the following baseline-parameters before tumor surgery:
- age, gender, co-morbidities, medications with doses, tumor grading, tumor size, dexterity, symptoms
- Resilience Short Scal

Next of kin of the above patients
- Collection of the following baseline-parameters before tumor surgery:
- Resilience Short Scale (RS-13)
- Brief Illness Perception Questionnaire (BIPQ) (German version: Glattacker et al.
- Treatment Expectation Questionnaire (TEX-Q) 
- Quality of Relationship

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Included are all patients > 18 years who are able to consent with a newly diagnosed brain tumor (glioma) as well as patients with meningioma. Patients need to be physiologically and psychologically able to complete the questionnaires of the study.
Exclusion criteria:
Excluded are all minors who are unable to consent and those with a psychiatric history of psychosis and/or bipolar disorder.
